questions.prompt: Which of these dishes come from Spain?
questions.fact: Gazpacho is a tomato soup served cold, from Andalusia in the hot south of Spain.

questions.prompt: Which of these singers started out in a boy band?
questions.fact: Justin Timberlake was in NSYNC, Harry Styles in One Direction and Robbie Williams in Take That.

questions.prompt: How many dots are there on a normal dice, counting all six sides?
questions.fact: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 makes 21, and opposite faces always add up to seven.

questions.prompt: How many players does a netball team have on the court?
questions.fact: Seven, and each wears a bib saying where they are allowed to go, from GS to GK.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.hint: Not the famous city on the Bosphorus. This one is in the middle of the country.
questions.fact: Atatürk made Ankara the capital in 1923, partly because it was far from the sea and hard to attack.

questions.prompt: Which scientist imagined a cat that is both alive and dead?
questions.fact: Erwin Schrödinger meant the cat as a joke, to show how strange quantum physics sounds.
